title: ULPF Failure Record Contract
description: Schema for quarantined pipeline failure records. Failure records never carry raw log content; they reference vaulted evidence by locator/hash only.

failure_id.description: Unique identifier for the failure record.

reason.description: Human-readable failure reason. Must not embed raw log content.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when the failure was recorded.

raw_ref.description: Optional reference to the vaulted raw record (no raw content).

raw_hash.description: Bare SHA-256 hex digest of the associated raw record, when known.

source_id.description: Identifier of the log source or origin.

source_context.description: Non-content processing context (e.g., record index, byte offsets).

event_id.description: Associated event identifier, when the failure occurred after eventization.
